'''Icequake Ridge''' was a north-facing ridge located in the [[Desolation Plains]] on the [[Whiterock Wastes]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. [[Brightmirror Road]] ran along the top of the ridge, and the [[Crescent Canyon tech depot]] was accessible via an entrance in the ridge.<ref name="TOR" />
